concerns.text: T008 (Imbalance Score calculation) is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depends on T006b (Data Download) and T007 (Descriptors). T006b and T007 are listed as [P] tasks in Phase 2, but T008 consumes their outputs. If T006b/T007 are not completed before T008 runs, T008 will fail. The task order implies T008 can run in parallel with T006b/T007, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

T030 and T031 (Correlation analysis) depend on T027 (Performance Degradation) and T008 (Imbalance Scores). T027 is in Phase 4 (US2) and T008 is in Phase 2. However, T030/T031 are listed in Phase 4 but depend on T008 which is in Phase 2. While T008 is earlier, the dependency chain is valid. However, T030/T031 also depend on T027 which is in the same phase. The ordering within Phase 4 is correct (T027 before T030/T031). The issue is that T008 is in Phase 2, but T030/T031 are in Phase 4. This is acceptable as long as Phase 2 completes before Phase 4. The real issue is T008's placement relative to T006b/T007.

T012 (Contract test for data schema) depends on T010b (Generate dataset.schema.yaml). T014 (Contract test for resampling schema) depends on T010c (Generate resampling.schema.yaml). T020 (Contract test for resampling logic) depends on T010c. T010b and T010c are marked [P] in Phase 2. T012, T014, T020 are in Phase 2 and 4. The dependency is correctly ordered (T010b/c before T012/14/20). However, T012 is in Phase 2, T014 is in Phase 2, T020 is in Phase 4. This is acceptable. The issue is that T010b/c are marked [P] but they must complete before T012/14/20. The [P] tag is misleading if they are not truly parallel-safe with their consumers.

T047 (Full pipeline execution) depends on T016, T027, T030. T016 is in Phase 3 (US1), T027 is in Phase 4 (US2), T030 is in Phase 4 (US2). T047 is in Phase 6 (Polish). The dependency is correctly ordered. However, T047 also depends on T030 which depends on T027 and T008. T008 is in Phase 2. The chain is valid. The issue is that T047 is marked [P] but it is a sequential execution of the entire pipeline. The [P] tag is incorrect for T047 as it cannot run in parallel with other tasks; it is a final integration step.

T006b (Download datasets) is marked [P] but it produces data that T007 (Descriptors) and T008 (Imbalance) consume. If T006b is not completed before T007/T008, the pipeline fails. The [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with T007/T008, which is incorrect. The task should not be marked [P] if it has consumers in the same phase.
